contentText: The G7 summit has focused on the future of AI, and the memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran. As it comes to a close, its French host is hailing it as the most successful summit in years. Among its successes is bringing Trump behind Ukraine, as he changes his posture in favour of Kyiv and Russian sanctions. To do so, France is dealing an exchange between support to the US deal with Iran against US support for Ukraine. FRANCE 24's Philip Turle tells us what to know on that final day from Evian.
